method: Fantasy strength of schedule by position for the 2026 NFL regular season (weeks 1-17; week 18 excluded as in ESPN/FantasyPros convention). Defense ratings = PPR fantasy points allowed per game to QB/RB/WR/TE, computed by this agent from nflverse weekly player stats (stats_player_week_2025.csv and _2024.csv, REG weeks 1-18, fantasy_points_ppr column; QB/RB/WR/TE by nflverse position; LA->LAR). Each season's table is schedule-adjusted (4for4 aFPA / Footballguys USOS style): points in each game are decomposed into league mean + offense effect + defense effect by alternating least-squares (10 iterations), so a defense is not penalized for facing strong offenses. Final rating = 0.75*adj2025 + 0.25*adj2024 (prior year at lower weight as a mild shrinkage; year-over-year r of points allowed is only ~0.2, see sos_notes.md). Team SOS = mean rating of opponents faced in the window (full = wk1-17, early = wk1-4, playoffs = wk15-17; bye weeks skipped). Rank 1 = easiest (opponents allow the most points); z-scores across the 32 teams, positive = easier. No numeric 2026 projection overlay was applied because no complete 1-32 projected defensive table could be retrieved; major 2026 defensive changes are listed per team in defense_ratings[team].notes_2026 and in sos_notes.md. League-average rating (pts/game allowed): {'QB': 16.43, 'RB': 21.94, 'WR': 31.45, 'TE': 13.0}.
scoring: PPR: pass yd 0.04, pass TD 4, INT -2, rush/rec yd 0.1, rush/rec TD 6, reception 1, fumble lost -2, 2-pt 2 (nflverse fantasy_points_ppr)
